BrochureContent.Content:
Dixon Residential Estate Agents are delighted to present No. 28 Brookford to the Rush property market.

Upon entering the property, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hallway, leading into the modern, extended open-plan kitchen and dining area. This impressive space is perfect for family living and entertaining, offering generous room for both everyday life and special occasions.

The bright and spacious living room is located to the front of the property, while the thoughtful layout of both the kitchen and living room allows for an abundance of natural light to flow through the home from both sides. The ground floor also features a guest bathroom and excellent under-stair storage.

Upstairs, the accommodation comprises a generous master bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, two further large double bedrooms, a well-appointed family bathroom, and additional storage space.

To the rear, the property boasts a large private garden, ideal for enjoying warm summer days, outdoor dining, and family activities.

Brookford is one of Rush’s most sought-after residential developments, offering an exceptionally convenient location. The property is within close proximity to the local park, Tesco, and is just a short walk or cycle from a wide range of amenities, including the beautiful North and South Beaches, excellent primary and secondary schools, sports clubs, and a variety of marine and leisure activities.

Rush town centre continues to thrive, with an ever-growing selection of cafés, restaurants, shops, and community facilities, making it an ideal place to call home.

Commuters are well catered for, with regular train services from Rush & Lusk Station providing fast access to Dublin City Centre and convenient connections to both the DART and Luas networks. The 33 and 33X Dublin Bus routes also provide excellent transport links, while the Fingal Express Rapid Coach Service offers direct access to UCD.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
